Chapter 6559: Grown Wings

Chapter 6559: Grown Wings

No one held back after the first swing. The veil of pretension crumbled due to Xian Chengtian’s harsh revelation.

Primal Yin Immortal Ghost barked back by reminding everyone of Chengtian’s unfilial treachery.

Chengtian’s eyes gleamed with murderous intent but this didn’t scare the opponent. Their heightened auras horrified spectators.

“Wings are grown, I see.” Chengtian said.

“You’re too kind, Brother. I suggest you stop here lest you make a fool of yourself.” The ghost responded.

“Luminous, I can see your confidence but is it warranted?” Chengtian said coldly.

The ghost felt suffocated but didn’t want to give up. He believed he was the master of his fate after escaping from immortals.

“You can try.” He didn’t yield: “It’s a different day.”

Their relationship was complex. Chengtian always had a superiority complex after being chosen by three ancient immortals. Others couldn’t enter his sight except the immortals.

As for Primal Yin Immortal Ghost, he was a brilliant genius reaching the top on his own. Alas, Chengtian didn’t think much of him.

Moreover, he was pathetic and required assistance. Therefore, they never stood on equal footing. He always had to put aside his pride when dealing with Chengtian.

Today, he needed to endure no longer. Defeating Chengtian might be a way to prove himself - the first step toward immortal ascension.

His eyes flashed brightly as pure yin power gathered and froze the flow of space. The presence of an overlord alone could change the laws of reality and crush countless lives into nothingness.

“They’ll fight.” Spectators in Heaven World shuddered, praying that destruction wouldn’t reach them.

“I see.” Chengtian recognized the change and said: “You wish to kill me and prove your dao, but can you?”

His confidence reflected his cultivation and resources. He was not alone and had an ongoing alliance with Life and Death Heaven and the two redemption grounds.

This was why the two redemption grounds didn’t seek him out despite his interference with Primal Yin Immortal Ghost. On the other hand, the ghost appeared alone.

He had a pact with Bao Pu but the guy was no longer around. Moreover, would Bao Pu choose him over Chengtian? The answer was not likely.

“Have to try to know.” The ghost arched his chest and extended his yin aura around Chengtian: “Times have changed, Brother. You are no longer in your prime.”

Chengtian understood many things upon hearing this and said: “I don’t know what kind of pact you have with others but none will come today.”

“I don’t need anyone, what about you?” The ghost asked confidently. If he could kill Chengtian, he could obtain further resources on top of killing a mental weakness from being a sycophant previously.

“Good, good. The wretched stray dog from back then is finally baring its fangs.” Chengtian laughed while looking otherworldly. His superior presence made the ghost feel jealous and irritated, wanting to drag him down from his pedestal.

“Come, Luminous. I will not only take your source of desires but will also cut you down. Know your place.” He declared, not allowing this inferior being to challenge his authority.

Today marked the showdown between two supreme overlords.
